thread:
maria: hey — hitting a weird one on sample-app publish, typegen produced a new tag (v1.4.0) but changelog and package.json stayed at v1.3.2. npm publish CI is failing because the release tooling sees a semver mismatch.
kevin: ugh, was that from the autogen pipeline? which step bumped the tag?
kevin: can you paste the publish log?
maria: pasted below — short log + the git tags it picked up.
build-bot: build #4387 started by maria — running publish checks
build-bot: error: release sanity check failed: detected version tag v1.4.0 but package.json.version == 1.3.2

```
> npm publish --access public
npm ERR! code EUNMETVER
npm ERR! version mismatch: tag v1.4.0 != package.json 1.3.2
Error: release sanity check failed
```

maria: typegen changed some parameter ordering in sdk-core which triggered a minor semver bump in the typegen output (weird because it should be patch). I think our typegen semver rules ran in the wrong mode.
olivia: do we run typegen with --semver=auto or explicit?
maria: auto — apparently the regen diff included a shape change (optional -> required) in a generated type in sample-app client, but that change is only due to a proto->openapi mapping tweak, not an actual user-visible breaking change.
kevin: hmm, so typegen over-approximated the impact. We need to avoid bumping tag unless CI-level tests fail. Can we short-circuit the tag step when regen diffs are only whitespace/ordering?
olivia: the current pipeline uses a heuristic: if any generated file changed, bump. That is too noisy. We should compute a semantic diff (ignore ordering/format) and only bump if interface-change.
sam: I can add a step to run 'type-diff --strict' which compares exported types and flags real API surface changes. Takes ~20s.
maria: that would help. For now, can we patch the tag to match package.json and re-run publish?
kevin: quick fix: create v1.3.3 tag and rerun release job, but we should revert the tag bump in typegen repo. Also add a CI guard so tag != package.json fails fast before pushing anywhere but doesn't block the whole pipeline.

maria: filed a tiny PR that disables semver=auto in sample-app CI and adds the strict type-diff step: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/912
kevin: nice. after that, let's re-run the publish job. @build-bot can you queue a retry once the PR merges? :pray:
build-bot: acknowledged — will retry publish on merge.

olivia: follow-up: let's also add a changelog check that ensures changelog entry present for minor/major bumps so we don't accidentally release skips.
sam: on it, will add the changelog gate to the release workflow and a tiny script to normalize generated files before diffing.
maria: thanks all — blocking release unblocked once PR merges and build-bot retries. :thumbsup:
